title: FToken: Factors as Tokens for Dual-Axis Cross-Sectional Return Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.30112v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On a given trading day, a stock-factor panel describes both how stocks differ across factors and how each factor varies across stocks. Most stock Transformers model relationships among stocks or across time. We introduce FToken, which also models relationships among factors. Its factor branch encodes all stocks' values for one factor as a token, applies self-attention across factors, and maps the result back to one return forecast per stock. A second branch applies attention across stocks in the same panel. A gate combines their forecasts using trailing factor covariance and market volatility. We evaluate both branches on NASDAQ, NYSE, and S&P 500 with the benchmarks' five price features and with 158 factors computed from the same data. On the 158-factor NASDAQ panel, averaging the two forecasts yields an information coefficient (IC) of 0.0421, compared with 0.0392 for the strongest external baseline. translated_title: FToken：以因子为Token的双轴横截面收益预测
translated_abstract: 在给定的交易日，股票-因子面板同时描述了股票在不同因子上的差异，以及每个因子在不同股票上的变化。大多数股票Transformer模型只建模股票之间或时间维度上的关系。我们提出了FToken，它还能建模因子之间的关系。其因子分支将某个因子在所有股票上的取值编码为一个token，在因子之间应用自注意力机制，并将结果映射回每只股票的一个收益预测。第二个分支则在同一面板的股票之间应用注意力机制。一个门控机制利用滞后因子协方差和市场波动率来组合两个分支的预测结果。我们在纳斯达克（NASDAQ）、纽约证券交易所（NYSE）和标普500（S&P 500）上评估了两个分支，使用基准的五个价格特征以及从相同数据计算出的158个因子。在包含158个因子的纳斯达克面板上，对两个预测取平均得到的信息系数（IC）为0.0421，而最强外部基线为0.0392。门控机制将IC进一步提升至0.0443。
tldr: FToken创新性地将因子作为token建模因子间关系，并结合跨股票注意力分支与基于因子协方差和市场波动率的门控融合机制，实现了优于最强基线的横截面收益预测（NASDAQ上IC达0.0443）。
en_tdlr: FToken innovatively treats factors as tokens to model inter-factor relationships, combining a factor branch with a cross-stock attention branch through a gate based on trailing factor covariance and market volatility, achieving superior cross-sectional return prediction (IC of 0.0443 on NASDAQ).
